title.de: Indirekte Rede: Backshift statt Konjunktiv I
title.en: Reported speech: backshift instead of the German subjunctive I

summary.de: Englisch verschiebt die Zeitform um eine Stufe, Deutsch nimmt den Konjunktiv I.
summary.en: English shifts the tense one step back; German uses the subjunctive I.

explanation.de: Deutsch markiert indirekte Rede mit dem Konjunktiv I: 'Er sagt, er sei krank.' Englisch hat dafuer keinen eigenen Konjunktiv, sondern verschiebt die Zeitform um eine Stufe zurueck (backshift), wenn das Einleitungsverb in der Vergangenheit steht: 'He said he was ill.' present wird past, past wird past perfect, will wird would, can wird could, must wird bei Pflicht had to. Auch Zeit- und Ortangaben wandern: today wird that day, tomorrow wird the next day, here wird there. Bei Einleitung im Praesens ('He says ...') bleibt die Zeitform erhalten.
explanation.en: German marks reported speech with the subjunctive I: 'Er sagt, er sei krank.' English has no dedicated subjunctive for this; instead it shifts the tense one step back when the reporting verb is in the past: 'He said he was ill.' present becomes past, past becomes past perfect, will becomes would, can becomes could, and must expressing obligation becomes had to. Time and place words shift too: today becomes that day, tomorrow becomes the next day, here becomes there. With a present reporting verb ('He says ...') the tense stays unchanged.

contrast.de: Deutsch: Konjunktiv I (sei, habe, werde), Zeitform bleibt inhaltlich gleich. Englisch: Backshift plus Anpassung von Pronomen und Zeitangaben; ein Konjunktiv I existiert nicht.
contrast.en: German: subjunctive I (sei, habe, werde), the tense keeps its meaning. English: backshift plus adjustment of pronouns and time references; there is no subjunctive I.

examples.de: Sie sagte, sie habe den Brief geschrieben.
examples.en: She said she had written the letter.

examples.de: Er sagte, er werde morgen kommen.
examples.en: He said he would come the next day.

hint.de: will wird would, morgen wird the next day
hint.en: will becomes would, tomorrow becomes the next day

pitfall.wrong: He said me he was tired.
pitfall.correct: He told me he was tired.

why.de: say ohne Personenobjekt, tell mit Personenobjekt: say (that) ... / tell somebody (that) ...
why.en: say takes no personal object, tell does: say (that) ... / tell somebody (that) ...

task.de: Forme in die indirekte Rede um: 'I will call you tomorrow', she said.
task.en: Report this: 'I will call you tomorrow', she said.

quick_check.solution: She said she would call me the next day.
accepted: She said that she would call me the following day.
